summary: Frontend-only Playwright test of new dynamic 'perioade de culpa' feature in RentCalculator. All 5 scenarios from review request pass: (1) '+ Reconstatare' and '+ Comanda piese' auto-number per-type (Reconstatare 1, Reconstatare 2, Comanda piese 1). (2) Start/end date inputs work; delete removes only that row and remaining rows renumber correctly. (3) After Calculeaza, chronology (Cronologie zile) shows 16-18.07 tagged 'reconstatare 1' (amber) and 19-20.07 tagged 'comanda piese 1' (amber); letter contains 'Perioada reconstatare 1 : 16.07.2026 - 18.07.2026 total 3 zile' and 'Perioada comanda piese 1 : 18.07.2026 - 20.07.2026 total 3 zile'. (4) Overlap dedup verified: 18.07.2026 appears exactly once in the chronology (5 unique culpa days across the two 3-day periods, not 6). (5) Baseline with no culpa produces 15 zile, valid letter, no Perioada culpa lines. Total zile increased from 15 (baseline) to 18 with culpa periods (Fri 17.07 was already counted as reparatie so only 3 new weekend/culpa days added: 18/19/20 Sat-Mon, correctly deduped).
critical_code_review_comments: RentCalculator.jsx payload build (line 178-184) recomputes per-type number using arr.slice(0, idx+1) INSIDE map on the filtered array; because filter runs first, indexes in the map callback are indexes of the filtered array so numbering stays consistent with what user sees in labels. Verified correct in test.

culpaLabelPlain uses 'comanda piese' (no diacritic) for backend payload while UI shows 'Comandă piese' - consistent because backend label is echoed in letter output; matches expected 'Perioada <label> :' format.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Dynamic culpa feature verified end-to-end on preview URL. Selectors: add-reconstatare-button, add-comanda-piese-button, culpa-period-row-{idx}, culpa-period-label-{idx}, culpa-start-input-{idx}, culpa-end-input-{idx}, remove-culpa-period-{idx}. Baseline default form gives 15 zile aprobate; with reconstatare 16-18.07 + comanda piese 18-20.07 gives 18 zile (overlap 18.07 counted once).
